answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 6901 Country: India Title: Asak ! I am student of Jawaharl lal Nehru University in New Delhi and doing research in the Centre for Study of Law and Governance. I want to ask that : Is subsidy for Haj provided by the Government of India valid or in accordance with the islamic principles or requirements? Question: Asak ! I am student of Jawaharl lal Nehru University in New Delhi and doing research in the Centre for Study of Law and Governance. I want to ask that : Is subsidy for Haj provided by the Government of India valid or in accordance with the islamic principles or requirements? Answer ID: 6901 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 963/885=L/1429) The subsidy offered by the Indian Government is allowed. There is no wrong in availing the facility. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
